notes: Larry does not list three or more framework names, or three or more /mos: commands, in one reply when the navigator did not ask for a list (SEED-116 direction 1; the three-name marker rule of research L5). The Stop observer logs one row per hit through detectFrameworkDump in lib/hmi/larry-reply-checks.cjs, in shadow mode only (A-04): it evaluates and logs, it never blocks. A blocking rung is a Phase 369.7 decision against a measured rate (R-14); promotion stays a human edit. min_true_positives uses the same sourced baseline as the other voice policies: the 50 to 100 human-reviewed-traces figure from Vanishing Gradients Ep. 57 (Shreya Shankar), low end adopted.
